summary: Add or update a Direct Entry value for a Budget Column and WBS Code
description: Add or update a direct entry value for a specific budget column and WBS Code in a project.

202.description: Direct entry value added or updated was accepted.

value.description: The direct entry amount to set for the given budget column and WBS code, as a decimal string. Replaces any existing direct entry value for that cell. Percent entries should be formatted as 10.0 for...

uom.description: Unit of measure for quantity direct entries. Required when the target budget column uses quantity format.
